alignments.note: Crasis spelling conjunction and adverb together; one aligned unit headed on the adverbial element under rule 55.
The periphrastic auxiliary ἦσαν is collapsed by the ASV into a simple past, and what answers to it is the subject its inflection licenses.

εὐαγγελίζω is denominal from εὐαγγέλιον, so the noun phrase the gospel is what glosses the lexeme and preached is the verbalizing support word; head on gospel under rules 66 and 91. Heading on preached remains defensible.

review_notes: The variant SBLGNT.ACT.14.7.v003 is underdetermined and its base reading is what the ASV translates, so no rule 97 note is owed.
ἦσαν is given the supplied subject they rather than being left unrepresented, the periphrasis being collapsed rather than untranslated.
